human_economic_burden.boundary: Access gap is retained as exposed need, not mortality attributed to cooling.

transformations.formula: Normalize the UNEP 2022 global cooling-emissions estimate without adding projected 2050 emissions.
Normalize UNEP lower-bound population lacking adequate cooling as exposure, not realized harm.
Retain the elapsed interval between the 2022 baseline and 2025 report.
Divide countries referencing cooling in climate or energy plans by 193 UN Member States.

receipts.uncertainty: Cooling-access definitions combine mechanical, passive and service-quality dimensions and vary by assessment. Current emissions are modeled sector estimates. The report does not attribute all heat deaths to absent cooling, provide a country-level access denominator, or supply an annual observation series.
receipts.freshness: UNEP Global Cooling Watch 2025 baseline year 2022; snapshot captured 2026-07-31T22:05:44.851Z.

selection_reason.selected_method_passed: UNEP quantifies global cooling emissions, capacity, unmet cooling need, assessment persistence and country-policy extent.
higher_priority_failures: No complete annual global equipment-and-refrigerant-bank series supplies the current-data magnitude and trend gate.
Projected 2050 demand and emissions are excluded from current scoring.

biophysical_burden.boundary: Cooperation coverage gap, not treaty breach or conflict incidence.

human_economic_burden.boundary: Shared-water exposure scope, not a population or monetary loss estimate.

transformations.formula: Subtract the official global SDG 6.5.2 average from 100 percent.
Retain the report-wide share of freshwater crossing borders as exposed governance scope.
Use the 2017 baseline to 2023 monitoring interval.
Divide countries sharing transboundary waters by 193 UN Member States.

receipts.uncertainty: National reports vary in completeness, aquifer delineation and interpretation of operationality. The coverage gap measures absent or incomplete operational arrangements; it does not prove treaty breach, conflict or service failure.
receipts.freshness: UNECE-UNESCO 2023 monitoring cycle published 2024; snapshot captured 2026-07-31T22:05:44.892Z.

selection_reason.selected_method_passed: UNECE-UNESCO quantifies the global operational-cooperation gap, shared-water scope, repeated monitoring span and worldwide country extent.
higher_priority_failures: The three global monitoring cycles do not meet the 20-annual-observation historical-percentile gate.
The assessment does not provide a current global treaty-breach incident series.

biophysical_burden.boundary: Observed aviation-category CO2 increase; no direct conversion from ICAO activity.

transformations.formula: Subtract EDGAR 2023 global civil-aviation fossil CO2 from the 2024 value; keep ICAO activity separate.
Normalize ICAO scheduled RPK growth without adding freight growth or projected traffic.
Retain the four-year observed recovery interval as persistence context.
Use ICAO reported global statistical coverage directly.

receipts.uncertainty: ICAO labels 2024 statistics preliminary. Scheduled-service coverage, revisions, traffic definitions and freight/passenger aggregation affect values. Passenger, RPK, freight and capacity measures are not additive. The workbooks do not report observation-level numeric uncertainty. Activity data, emission factors, country allocation, sector classification, international bunker treatment, revisions and category coverage affect values. Air-pollutant emissions are inventories, not ambient concentrations or attributable health burdens.
receipts.freshness: ICAO and EDGAR 2024 global observations; snapshots captured 2026-07-31T22:05:44.934Z and 2026-07-31T14:58:58.195Z.

selection_reason.selected_method_passed: ICAO quantifies global passenger and freight growth while EDGAR independently quantifies the corresponding aviation-category CO2 increase and long-lived global pressure.
higher_priority_failures: ICAO activity histories are not yet ingested as a complete 20-year global annual panel.
Activity growth is not converted to emissions; the independently observed EDGAR increment makes this an impact fallback.
